description.zh: 阿里云订单 ID（含虚拟订单）
description.en: The Alibaba Cloud order ID. This includes virtual orders.
The description of the activation code.

description.zh: 激活码的名称，仅允许使用英文、数字、下划线、中划线命名，方便控制台下载时生成激活码文件名称
description.en: The name of the activation code. It can contain only letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). This name is used as the filename when you download the activation code from the console.

description.zh: 数据库唯一标志。如果订单的 AllowEmptySystemIdentifier 为 false，则该字段为必填。
description.en: The unique identifier of the database. This parameter is required if \`AllowEmptySystemIdentifier\` for the order is set to \`false\`.

title.zh: 生成轻量化版本激活码

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-activation-code --aliyun-order-id 22330000445566 --mac-address 12:34:56:78:98:00 --system-identifier 1234567890123456 --description testCode --name testName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb CreateActivationCode --region cn-hangzhou --AliyunOrderId 22330000445566 --Description testCode --SystemIdentifier 1234567890123456 --MacAddress '12:34:56:78:98:00' --Name testName
